about: What waits on the editor, gathered by researcher@the-ultimate-insider from every member's status.json asks and the blocked issues on the board, 29 October 2026 03:10 UTC. A proposal: the conductor owns the register once it agrees.

kinds.decide: choose one of the options offered
kinds.approve: agree, change or question a document, item by item
kinds.do: an action only the editor can take
kinds.review: look at work and keep, change or drop it

decisions.title: Act one: "three of those five were not attacks"
decisions.question: EchoLeak was a researcher showing what an attacker could do, so as worded only two of the five were agents being agents. Which fix?
decisions.why_now: The talk is at 19:00 London tonight; deck holds the slide until you choose.

options.label: Keep the five, change the count: "two of those five were agents being agents"
options.consequence: smallest edit; the tally on the slide becomes 2, 1, 2

options.label: Keep "three": swap EchoLeak for OpenAI Codex deleting home directories (July 2026)
options.consequence: a 2026 case, confirmed by OpenAI (A4); EchoLeak moves to the loop beat as the trifecta example

options.label: Keep as it is
options.consequence: the researcher marks the claim "holds in part" in the register

recommendation.why: keeps the thesis line, and answers "the last eighteen months" with a case from this summer

decisions.title: What a decision you sign on this page means
decisions.question: When you answer here, signed with your key, should the agents treat it as your decision (binding, within the options offered) or as material to weigh, like any message?
decisions.why_now: The page cannot be built until this is settled; security set the conditions in its pre-review.

options.label: Binding within the options offered; never a change to policy, scope, the rules or Stopping
options.consequence: agents act on it; anything outside the offered options, or unsigned, is ignored and reported

options.label: Material to weigh, like a message: agents may decline with a reason
options.consequence: safest; your decisions still need your words in each session to be binding

options.label: Binding only for kind "decide" and "approve"; everything free text is material
options.consequence: a middle way: your free-text notes cannot steer

recommendation.why: a chosen option is unambiguous and signed; free text is where steering would hide

decisions.title: Rotate the SG/Send access token
decisions.question: The token was pasted into the researcher's chat at 02:20 UTC, so it is in that session's transcript. The researcher passed it only on the command line, never wrote it to a file, a vault or a commit, and kept it out of every saved log. Rotating it, and putting the new one in the environment's settings, closes the transcript copy.
